matrixCases.reason: Jsoup retains non-<option> elements inside <select>, whereas WHATWG HTML5 (parse5) drops disallowed start tags in 'in select' insertion mode.
WHATWG HTML5 (parse5) closes <select> upon seeing <textarea>, whereas Jsoup nests <textarea> inside <select>.
Jsoup retains leading whitespace text nodes before <html>, whereas WHATWG HTML5 (parse5) drops whitespace in initial/before-html mode.
Jsoup keeps trailing whitespace after </body> as a child of <html>, whereas WHATWG HTML5 (parse5) re-inserts after-body whitespace into <body>.
Inside <select> with malformed tags around <template>, parse5 drops <nobr> and keeps <template> directly under <select>, whereas Jsoup keeps <nobr> wrapping <template>.
Inside <template><table><form>, parse5 follows WHATWG in-table form pointer rules and drops the empty <form>, whereas Jsoup retains <form> under <table>.
